name: Gorillium
summary:
Gorillium is an immersive VR experience that lets you unleash your inner gorilla in a high-energy world of climbing, swinging, and exploration. Navigate through a massive treetop playground built with intricate wooden platforms, tall trees, and hidden routes — all designed to test your agility and creativity.
